thread:
julia: Heads-up: planning a slim-base refresh for runtime pool Tue 08:00 PT. Objectives: remove legacy deps, rotate cosign key, ensure audit records tie image SHA -> SBOM -> signature. Need quick RBAC + KMS sign checks before canary.

marco: Plan: rolling canary 3 cohorts (5%, 25%, rest) with 20m windows and automated SBOM+sig verification after each wave.

tessa: Good. On RBAC: signer needs kms.cryptoKeySigner. Also grant ops-verifier publicKeyViewer so cosign verify works cross-project.

marco: Minimal IAM snippet (GCP):
```
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner -> serviceAccount:runtime-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
+ roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer -> serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

infra-bot: CI scan: candidate image shows allowlist drift on openssl (minor version). Link: https://ci.internal/scan/17455 (warning).

tessa: I'll triage openssl against NVD and our internal DB. If no CVE it's non-blocking; will post SBOM diff.

oncall: Rollback playbook snippet I'll keep ready. Trigger conditions: >4% error rate or signature mismatch. Commands: 
```
# revert registry tag to previous sha
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy previous image
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:prev-sha -n runtime || kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n runtime
```

julia: Ops wants sample audit event shape. Quick example: 
```
{"image_sha":"sha256:ffee0011","sbom_path":"gs://sboms/sha256-ffee.json","signature_ref":"projects/.../keys/.../signatures/99","deployed_by":"serviceAccount:ci-deployer","ts":"2025-06-10T15:00:00Z"}
```

marco: Triage update: openssl bump has no CVEs in NVD/internal DB. Non-blocking. SBOM diff will be attached.

julia: Action items: 1) @marco open infra MR for kms:Sign + publicKeyViewer, 2) @tessa attach SBOM diff and triage note, 3) @oncall add rollback snippet to runbook and watch Tue morning, 4) I'll schedule cohorts and post runbook link.

marco: MR opened: https://git.internal/infra/mr/5982 (terraform diff + tests). Please review.

infra-bot: Reminder: ensure attestor emits auditlog write events so we can correlate promotion activities.

julia: Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge after approvals and proceed with Tue plan.

tessa: ✅ from vuln triage.

oncall: I'll be on watch during the window and will escalate to #incidents if needed.
